sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and a strong record of seven wins, one draw, and two defeats, so a single setback should not derail their title push against struggling Alsager, who sit bottom with just four points.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday as part of a busy matchday where all ten other fixtures kick off simultaneously at 15:00. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between third and fifth, while in-form Bilston Town (third-most points) visit Foley Meir. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, face Wednesfield Community at home before meeting Brereton Social away on Wednesday evening. Barnton entertain Shawbury United, with the latter on a concerning six-game losing run, while Crewe host Allscott Heath, Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town, and Market Drayton Town travel to New Mills. The midweek Wednesday fixture between Brereton Social (15th, mixed form) and Wednesfield Community (9th, recent upturn with a win) adds interest to an otherwise straightforward Saturday programme.
